meta.name: Recruiter Agent — Burgundy/Gray Flat
meta.description: Shared design identity for the AI Recruitment Agent landing page + dashboard. Dark, premium, editorial, engineered. Burgundy + gray only. STRICTLY no gradients (flat fills).
source_references: user brief: burgundy + gray, no gradients, dark premium editorial engineered

primary.role: primary burgundy — CTAs, active data, key accents

secondary.role: deep burgundy — pressed states, filled bars, section markers

accent.role: bright wine — hover, focus rings, highlights

neutral.usage: bg → surface → card → elevated → border → muted-border → text-muted → text-secondary → text → text-bright

semantic.error: #7E7E86 on dashed border (negative expressed as muted gray + iconography, NO red)

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast text on near-black; depth via flat surface steps + 1px solid borders, NOT shadows or gradients

typography.font_style_notes: Grotesk display for editorial-engineered headlines; Inter for readable body; JetBrains Mono for overlines, data labels, metrics, and technical chrome (reinforces the 'engineered instrument' feel).

spacing.content_density: comfortable on landing, compact-precise on dashboard
spacing.section_rhythm: large 96–160px vertical rhythm on landing; tight 16–32px grid on dashboard

layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric editorial on landing; strict grid on dashboard

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px solid #2C2C31 everywhere; the primary depth + structure device
shape.divider_style: 1px solid #2C2C31, occasionally a 1px burgundy rule (#6A1528) as a section marker

elevation.shadow_style: none — flat. Depth = solid surface color steps + 1px borders. (NO soft shadows, NO gradients.)

motion.philosophy: precise, engineered, restrained-cinematic; motion confirms structure, never decorates

components.button_style: primary = flat burgundy #94243F fill, #F4F4F6 text, 8px radius, no shadow; hover → #B23A4E (flat color swap, NO gradient). secondary = transparent + 1px #2C2C31 border. ghost = text + burgundy underline on hover.
components.input_style: flat #141416 fill, 1px #2C2C31 border, focus → 1px #B23A4E border (no glow/gradient)
components.card_style: flat #1A1A1D, 1px #2C2C31 border, 12px radius, no shadow; hover → border #3A3A40
components.navigation_pattern: thin fixed top bar, mono wordmark left, links right, flat #0D0D0F with 1px bottom border
components.modal_style: flat #1A1A1D panel, 1px border, backdrop = solid #0D0D0F at 80% opacity (flat, no blur)
components.list_style: row dividers 1px #2C2C31, mono metadata, generous row height
components.component_notes: Everything flat-filled. The only 'accent' is burgundy. Borders + type scale + mono labels carry the engineered look.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: an instrument panel for an autonomous machine — a control room in oxblood and graphite

visual_language.ornamentation: none — structure IS the ornament (borders, grids, mono labels)
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous on landing, dense-precise on dashboard
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy type + one burgundy focal per view; rest neutral
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element on landing; single primary metric per dashboard cluster
visual_language.contrast_level: high (bright text on near-black; burgundy pops against gray)
visual_language.texture_usage: optional very-subtle static grain overlay (~3% opacity) for premium paper feel — flat noise, NOT a gradient

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast + burgundy color weight + spatial isolation
composition.negative_space_role: primary — lets the oxblood accents and headlines breathe

imagery.photo_treatment: none / duotone burgundy-gray if ever used
imagery.graphic_elements: 1px rules, grid ticks, mono coordinates, NO gradients, NO blobs
imagery.pattern_usage: fine dot-grid or crosshair ticks at low opacity

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate, crisp; flat color swaps + 1px border shifts
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: burgundy border/underline reveal; magnetic pull on primary CTA only
interaction_feel.loading_style: mono skeleton rows + a thin burgundy progress rule
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: restrained — a few high-quality moments, not everywhere

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative ('Deploy the agent', 'View the pipeline')
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: mono, matter-of-fact ('No applications yet — the agent runs on a schedule.')

overview.fallback_strategy: prefers-reduced-motion or low-end (hardwareConcurrency<=4) → static burgundy wireframe still-frame, no WebGL loop

background_effects.description: Static, very-low-opacity monochrome grain overlay for premium texture. NOT animated, NOT a gradient.
background_effects.technology: tiled PNG/SVG noise or a one-time canvas draw

particle_systems.description: Hero: a slowly drifting constellation of gray points connected by thin burgundy lines — 'a network of opportunities the agent traverses'. Flat-shaded, no glow.

3d_elements.description: Central slowly-rotating low-poly/wireframe form (icosahedron network) in burgundy wireframe over the node field; scroll dollies the camera through/past it.

params.lighting: minimal — flat/emissive burgundy wireframe, one dim key light; no dramatic speculars
params.materials: MeshBasicMaterial wireframe (#94243F) + PointsMaterial (#A6A6AE) — FLAT, no gradient maps
params.post_processing: none by default (keep flat/crisp). Optional very-subtle bloom OFF unless requested.
params.interaction_model: scroll-driven camera; light pointer parallax; no orbit controls on landing

shader_effects.description: Avoid — shaders tend toward gradients; keep flat.

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: hero camera = scrubbed; section reveals = triggered-once

text_effects.description: Hero headline reveals by word with a stagger + clip mask. NO gradient text fill.

cursor_effects.description: Primary CTA only: subtle magnetic pull toward cursor.

canvas_drawings.description: Dashboard charts use flat SVG bars, not canvas.

svg_animations.description: Thin burgundy connector lines in the 'how it works' agent-chain draw in on scroll; dashboard sparklines draw in.

visual_effects.composite_notes: HARD RULE: zero gradients anywhere (no linear/radial/conic gradients, no gradient text, no gradient borders, no mesh gradients, no bloom-glow by default). All fills are flat solid colors from the burgundy+gray tokens. Depth is achieved ONLY via flat surface color steps and 1px solid borders. Charts are flat burgundy-monochrome bars/lines on gray. The 3D hero is flat-shaded wireframe + points. A single static ~3% grain overlay is the only permitted texture. Landing = immersive/editorial; dashboard = precise instrument. Both share the exact same tokens.
